name: cavemio-hold-to-confirm
title: Hold to confirm
description: A deliberate action, held for a moment: the ring fills, the label changes, and confirmation settles into a check.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Hold the pointer, Space or Enter to confirm. Key repeat does not restart the timer, and a normal click never triggers the callback.
- Releasing early, leaving the button, losing focus, Escape or a hidden browser tab cancels an incomplete hold. A completed action continues through its promise.
- State announcements live outside the button. The button retains focus while pending or showing its result.
- Reduced motion removes icon movement and spinning. The functional progress ring still communicates the hold duration.
- Use clear action labels and provide undo in your application where appropriate.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: – · Runs once after the hold threshold. Resolves to success or rejects to error.

props.name: duration
props.description: 1100 · Required hold in milliseconds, clamped to 300–5000.

props.name: resetAfter
props.description: 2200 · Delay before returning to idle. Set 0 to keep the result visible.

props.name: labels
props.description: – · Labels for idle, holding, pending, success and error.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: – · Every change of state, e.g. to move something else in step with the hold.

props.name: icon
props.description: – · Idle and holding icon. Defaults to a fingerprint.

props.name: disabled
props.description: false · Disables the action and cancels an active hold.

features.title: Intent without a dialog
features.description: Press and hold while a fine ring fills round the icon. The hold takes 1.1 seconds by default, between 0.3 and 5.

features.title: Letting go cancels
features.description: Releasing early, pressing Escape, leaving the button or losing focus resets the ring.

features.title: It runs once
features.description: The callback runs once after the hold, and a normal click never triggers it.

features.title: It shows the result
features.description: The label morphs, a spinner shows while the promise runs, then a drawn check or an alert.

features.title: Retry with another hold
features.description: If the callback fails, the button shows the error and the next hold tries again.

features.title: Works from the keyboard
features.description: Hold Space or Enter. Key repeat doesn’t restart the timer, and announcements live outside the button.

states.title: hold
states.description: The icon ring fills linearly over the configured threshold (1100ms by default). A short press does not confirm.

states.title: release
states.description: Early release, Escape, focus loss or pointer interruption cancels the hold. The ring resets over 240ms.

states.title: pending
states.description: After the threshold, the callback runs once. The label morphs and the progress icon gives way to a spinner.

states.title: success / error
states.description: A resolved callback draws a check; a rejected callback shows an alert and offers another hold. The button resets after 2200ms by default.
